description: This file defines an interface named RequestEvent in the package com.icontrol.event. It includes a method getRequestId() meant to be implemented by classes representing events stemming from server requests that contain a request identifier.

classes.name: RequestEvent
classes.description: An interface for events originating from a server request, providing access to the request ID.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the event.
